title: Numbers from bytes
description:
Read numbers from a byte buffer in both byte orders, safely.

```
bytes: 01 00 00 00 2a 00 00 00 00 00 00 80
little endian u32 at 0: 1
little endian u32 at 4: 42
big endian u32 at 4: 704643072
this machine is little endian
```
hints: `*reinterpret_cast<const std::uint32_t*>(p + 1)` may be misaligned and breaks the aliasing rules; `memcpy` has neither problem.
requirements: `std::uint32_t readLE32(const unsigned char* p)` and `readBE32` with shifts.
Detect the machine's own order with `std::endian` (C++20) or by looking at the bytes of `1`.
Show that `std::memcpy` into a `std::uint32_t` is the safe way to reinterpret bytes, and that casting the pointer is not.
stretch: Read a 64-bit value and a `float` the same way.
